ModMetaData.name: Control Groups
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
StarCraft-style control groups for pawns, animals, mechs and buildings.
- Ctrl+number (Cmd+number also works on Mac): select the group; press twice quickly to jump the camera to it - Alt+number (Option+number on Mac): assign the selected pawns to group 0-9 - Shift+number: add the selected pawns to the group - Plain number keys stay as game speed keys - Groups are saved with the game and can include pawns on other maps or in caravans
Selection grid (when 2 or more things are selected): - A StarCraft-style grid of portraits/icons appears above the inspect pane - Each cell shows health, plus hunger (people/animals) or power (mechs), and mood as a background fill that turns red at break risk - Drafted pawns are outlined in red - Click a cell to select only that one, Shift+click to remove it, Ctrl/Cmd+click to keep only that kind - The "-" button collapses the grid to a small tab
